captions.detailed: A realistic, industrial-grade CCTV security mast featuring a tall, slender vertical support pole anchored to a circular base plate. Mounted halfway up the pole is a small, rectangular electrical junction box with a thin, black flexible conduit/cable running upwards into the camera assembly. At the top of the pole sits a pan-tilt surveillance camera head, consisting of a dark cylindrical panning collar, a U-shaped tilting bracket, and a rectangular camera housing with a dark glass lens element.
captions.instruction: Create a detailed 3D model of an industrial CCTV surveillance mast using CadQuery. The assembly should feature a tall vertical support pole with a circular base flange, a mid-height utility junction box with an attached flexible cable, and a fully articulated pan-tilt camera assembly at the top, including a panning base, a U-bracket, and a rectangular camera body with a lens.
captions.factory: Construct the support pole using a cylinder for the main shaft and a wider, thin cylinder for the base flange. Model the junction box as a box primitive and extrude a thin, curved path to represent the flexible cable. Build the pan-tilt head by stacking a cylindrical panning collar, a custom U-shaped bracket made by combining box primitives or extruding a profile, and a rectangular camera body with a cylindrical lens cut or addition. Define rotational joints (revolute articulations) for the panning collar around the Z-axis and the camera body tilt around the Y-axis.
